description.narrative: C-BLUES has the overall objective to advance our knowledge and broad understanding of carbon stocks, sequestration, and drivers of greenhouse gas (GHG) fluxes in blue carbon ecosystems (BCE) to facilitate and promote scientific reporting of inventories from managed BCE under the IPCC Wetlands guidelines. The C-BLUES will provide new evidence to promote optimal investment and management practices. This project spans from local management and interactions with local stakeholders to global assessments of carbon sequestration capacity of European and Chinese BCE. C-BLUES will therefore be a catalysis to hasten progressive management of coastal wetlands and increased reporting to the UNFCCC.
